title: 265,000 board feet of lumber came down a wire to Zion Lodge #Shorts
description:
Two hundred and sixty-five thousand board feet of lumber, down a wire. That's how Zion Lodge was built in nineteen twenty-five. A tramway on Cable Mountain lowered the wood more than two thousand vertical feet to the canyon floor.

▶ Full documentary (Zion, Part 2: The Day the Mountain Fell: Zion's Lost Lake): https://youtu.be/1KUANk1uGtU

#Shorts #Zion #ZionLodge #History #NationalParks
